About College
Welcome to
Gogamukh college, a pioneer institution of higher education in Dhemaji district situated towards the north-eastern corner of assam, was established in the year 1981. It is idealy situated between Gogamukh Higher Secondary School and Gogamukh Girls School about 1.2 kms from Gogamukh chariali. The greater Gogamukh area comprising of Gogamukh, Mingmang, Nalbari, Bordoibam, Chauldhua, Halakhbari, Naharbari etc is a vast rural and backward area. It is inhabited by Tribal castes like the Mshing, Bodo, Sonowal Kachari, Deori, Tiwa etc, Schedule Caste like Koibarttas and other backward class people like the Ahum, Chutias and also other caste people like the Nepalees etc. The whole area is socio-economically and educationally backward.                    ...
